subject: gov.policy
name: National Broadband Promotion and Universal Access Strategy
milestone: Final strategy and action plan issued, February 2019
position_end: A two-volume study for the higher education and technology ministry: the strategy volume sets quantified coverage and capacity objectives, market segments and an indicative budget, with regulatory action on the wholesale market, a wholesale catalogue and tariff structure, and the action-plan volume carries the measures. It calls for a National Broadband Plan to be put in place
note: seven years old and the base holds no adoption instrument, implementation report or successor; whether the National Broadband Plan it calls for was ever made is not established

subject: gov.policy
name: National Digital Payment Strategy 2023-2028
milestone: Strategy document issued by the central bank, 12 September 2024
position_end: The central bank's strategy for 2023-2028, presented as an extension of the financial inclusion strategy, carries a diagnostic of the payments ecosystem and five objectives: easing the regulation of payment and electronic money institutions to attract fintech investment, modernising payment infrastructure including an instant-payment system, modernising financial services around innovation, building usage through financial education, and multi-stakeholder governance across the ministries, the central bank and the telecoms regulator
note: the strategy text and its project portfolio are held; no implementation report, budget line or measured outturn against its five objectives is on file

subject: gov.policy
name: National Digital Transformation Agenda 2022-2025
milestone: Successor agenda to 2030 announced as in preparation, 4 December 2025
position_start: In force, in its final years
position_end: The agenda document of June 2022 sets a vision, objectives, strategic orientations, implementation levers and project sheets for 2022-2025; its term has run out and the ministry announced on 4 December 2025 that preparation of a National Digital Transformation Agenda 2030 had begun. No successor text is published
sources: 2022-06-01-mtnima-agenda-national-transformation-numerique-2022-2025|2025-12-04-ami-lancement-preparation-agenda-national-transformation-numerique-2030|2023-11-27 Setting the agenda for digital transformation
note: the 2022 agenda is now held as the ministry's own document rather than at second hand; no implementation report, budget outturn or project-by-project status against its sheets is published

subject: gov.policy
name: National electronic commerce strategy
milestone: Validation workshop held, 28 October 2025
position_start: A UN trade body's readiness assessment of 2024 and no national strategy
position_end: A validation workshop for a national electronic commerce strategy was held on 28 October 2025; the assessment behind it, published in 2024, reviewed the country's readiness for electronic commerce including its payment arrangements. No strategy text or adoption instrument is held
note: a validation workshop is the last dated step on the record; nothing states whether the strategy was adopted afterwards

subject: gov.policy
name: National Electronic Participation Policy
milestone: Technical assistance for a citizen participation platform provisionally awarded, 7 May 2026
position_start: A draft policy document proposed by a UN regional commission in December 2023, with no adoption instrument
position_end: The policy is still held as the December 2023 draft, benchmarked against Tunisia, Morocco and Denmark and carrying a vision, strategic objectives and an assessment of the country's current e-participation; against it, technical assistance for the development of a citizen participation platform was provisionally awarded under the regional digital integration programme on 7 May 2026
note: a provisional award is not a contract; no supplier, value, scope or delivery date is published, and the policy itself carries no adoption instrument

subject: gov.policy
name: National Financial Inclusion Strategy 2023-2028
milestone: Published by the central bank for 2023-2028
position_end: The central bank's strategy for 2023-2028, setting out the geography of regions and networks, the incidence of poverty and the divide between Nouakchott, the other towns and the rural areas as the terms on which financial inclusion is to be widened
note: the strategy text is held; no annual implementation report, target series or measured outturn against it is on file

subject: gov.policy
name: Ride-hailing authorisation compliance deadline
milestone: Fifteen-day deadline set by communique of 21 August 2026
position_end: The road transport regulator gave ride-hailing companies operating through digital applications 15 days to bring their authorisations into line with the law, in a communique reported as published on 21 August 2026 and warning that failure within the deadline could bring legal proceedings including suspension of the activity, with no further notice or warning required; the regulator set the warning against growing use of digital platforms for transport services
note: no operator is named and no count of non-compliant authorisations is given

subject: gov.legislate
name: Access to and use of public information bill
milestone: Bill welcomed publicly by a press-freedom organisation, 23 June 2026
position_end: A bill on access to and use of public information, presented as making good a presidential commitment; the press-freedom organisation that welcomed it asks for strengthened guarantees. No text, tabling date or parliamentary step is held
note: the account is an advocacy organisation's; nothing from the government or parliament on the bill is on file

subject: gov.legislate
name: ANETA state digital agency proposal
milestone: Named 'Agence Numérique de l'État' (AN-État) and proposed as national interoperability operator in a June 2023 strategy, reviving a 2021 UNDP proposal
position_end: Proposed by UNDP (31 July 2021) as an EPA under the digital ministry with about 50 staff, EUR 220,000 to set up and EUR 1.4m a year to run, and a draft creation decree; a June 2023 open-data strategy proposes reviving that decree to name the same body national interoperability operator; no adoption, decree or launch is on record
note: whether the 2023 strategy's 'AN-État' is the same proposal as 2021's ANETA is not stated explicitly, but the acronym, mandate and sponsoring ministry match

subject: gov.legislate
name: Civil Status Code and its 2025 amendment
milestone: Law 2025-011 replacing provisions of the 2011 Code, 24 February 2025
position_start: Law 2011-003 of 12 January 2011, which repealed and replaced the 1996 Code and created the national population register
position_end: Law 2025-011 repeals and replaces certain provisions of the 2011 Code; the 2011 instrument remains the frame, having established the civil status code and the national population register behind it
note: both texts are held in Arabic; the base does not hold a consolidated version, so which provisions the 2025 law changed is not established from the record

subject: gov.legislate
name: Cybercrime Law 2016-007
milestone: Promulgated 2016
position_end: In force, defining computer data, subscriber data and traffic data and setting the offences and procedure for cybercrime; it is the instrument the base holds for criminal cyber law, published by the digital ministry
note: the law's own text is held; no prosecution count, case record or amendment is on file, so the statute is dated and its use is not

subject: gov.legislate
name: Decree 2022-009 on electronic exchanges with and between administrations
milestone: Published at Journal Officiel n. 1505
position_end: In force, made on the report of the digital transition ministry under the electronic transactions law n. 2018-022 of 12 June 2018, and governing electronic exchanges between users and administrative authorities and between administrative authorities themselves
note: it is the legal footing the service portals rest on; no implementing arrangement, register of compliant administrations or evaluation is held

subject: gov.legislate
name: Investment Code 2025 and its single-window decree
milestone: Application decree 2025-117 made 14 August 2025
position_end: Law n. 2025-006 of 19 February 2025 carries the investment code, and decree n. 2025-117 of 14 August 2025 applies certain of its provisions, including the single-window arrangement for investors
note: both texts are held; no operating single window, service list, processing time or investor count is on the record

subject: gov.legislate
name: National Archives bill
milestone: Adopted in Council of Ministers, 4 March 2026
position_end: A bill on the national archives went through the Council of Ministers on 4 March 2026, in the same session that named the orientation council of the national statistics agency. No text or parliamentary step is held
note: the record is the Council communique; nothing states how the bill treats electronic records or the retention duties that would follow from it

subject: gov.legislate
name: Startup Act
milestone: Loi n° 2024-002 P.R relative aux start-ups technologiques et innovantes promulgated 2 January 2024
position_start: Draft bill in public consultation, targeting 300 labelled start-ups and 3,000 jobs over five years
position_end: Enacted 2 January 2024; the promulgated text is not held, but the ministry's pre-enactment deck sets out a merit-based label with a preferential public-procurement margin (Article 13), a state-backed start-up fund and guarantee fund with investor tax incentives (Article 21), payroll-cost relief and a technology-innovation hub, and IP and customs relief
note: the promulgated text of Loi n° 2024-002 itself is not held

subject: gov.legislate
name: Universal Service Access Fund governance
milestone: Decree centralising the fund's resources at the Treasury, 31 July 2026
position_end: A new decree centralises the resources of the universal access fund at the public Treasury, moving them out of the fund's own account and into the single treasury arrangement
note: the decree text is not held and no figure for the fund's balance, annual receipts or committed projects accompanies the change

subject: gov.protect
name: Data protection authority
milestone: Strategic plan 2023-2026 published; monthly meetings on record through June 2026
position_end: Operating under a published strategic plan for 2023-2026, meeting monthly with minutes issued: the meetings on record cover the framework for inspections and the sworn agents who carry them out, an opinion on interconnecting the integrated 'Maadeni' system with the national population register, the transfer and cloud deliberations of 2025, and the hosting of data inside the country with a certification route for the national data centre
note: the record is the authority's own minutes and plan; no budget, staffing, caseload or sanction figure is published, so activity is dated and capacity is not

subject: gov.protect
name: Data protection law and enforcement record
milestone: Law 2017-020 of 22 July 2017; deliberations 004 and 005 of 2025, the latter amended April 2026
position_end: Law n. 2017-020 of 22 July 2017 on the protection of personal data is the instrument, and the authority has begun issuing under it: deliberation 004/2025 sets the conditions and procedural rules for transferring personal data abroad, with a list of countries treated as adequate, and deliberation 005/2025 sets the minimum conditions for using cloud services hosted abroad. The amended text of 005/2025, published 30 April 2026, requires public and private cloud users to obtain prior authorisation for processing personal data abroad, a separate transfer authorisation where the host country is not on the approved list, and contractual guarantees covering compliance with the 2017 law, a data-transfer clause, return of the data on expiry and its permanent deletion by the provider thereafter
note: the amended text of 005/2025 does not state which articles changed from the original, and its page dateline is internally inconsistent; neither the adequate-country list nor a register of authorisations, complaints or sanctions is published, so enforcement remains unmeasured

subject: gov.regional
name: African Charter on Statistics position
milestone: Position recorded on the Union's signature and ratification list
position_end: The African Union's own list of countries that have signed, ratified or acceded to the African Charter on Statistics carries Mauritania's position as at September 2023
note: the list is held as a document; nothing on file records an implementing step, a domestic instrument or a reporting obligation arising from it

subject: gov.regional
name: Arab Maghreb Union treaty
milestone: Concluded at Marrakesh, 17 February 1989
position_end: In force since 1 July 1989 with a binding judicial organ, and no summit held since 1994 - a legal frame for regional harmonisation with no active machinery behind it

subject: gov.regional
name: ECOWAS statistics harmonisation memorandum
milestone: Memorandum announced for signature, 16 November 2025
position_end: The regional commission announced it would sign a memorandum with Mauritania on harmonising and improving statistics in west and central Africa, under the regional statistics programme
note: the account is of an intention to sign; no signed text, date, value or work programme is on the record, and Mauritania is not an ECOWAS member state

subject: gov.regional
name: Electoral commission memorandum with the European Union
milestone: Memorandum signed at Nouakchott, 2 February 2026
position_end: The independent national electoral commission signed a memorandum of understanding with the European Union at Nouakchott on 2 February 2026, under the European support programme for electoral institutions
note: no value, duration or work programme is stated, and nothing on file says whether electoral technology or the voter register is within its scope

subject: gov.regional
name: Morocco justice digital transformation agreement
milestone: Agreement signed by the two justice ministers, 21 October 2025
position_end: The justice minister signed an agreement with his Moroccan counterpart covering, among other things, the digital transformation of the justice sector
note: the agreement text is not held and no value, duration, deliverable or work programme is stated; the record is a ministry news item in Arabic

subject: gov.regional
name: Senegal-Mauritania digital cooperation memorandum
milestone: Signed January 2025
position_end: Signed; no deliverable, workstream or funding under it is on record

subject: gov.standards
name: National framework for public digital service standards
milestone: Three-day standards and interoperability workshop run by the digital ministry
position_end: Under development with German support through GIZ and the Digital-Y project; no framework or standard has been published

subject: gov.standards
name: National IPv6 transition strategy
milestone: A 68-page strategy targeting 25% adoption by 2026, with a national committee
position_start: In force, with a 25% by 2026 target and a national transition committee
position_end: In force; the target is unmet with the deadline approaching
note: the strategy carries no printed adoption date and its sector economic-impact figures are lifted from a consultancy report and cited rather than measured

subject: gov.standards
name: National Standardisation Council and Accreditation Committee
milestone: Created by decree 2023-113 of 7 September 2023
position_end: Decree n. 2023-113 of 7 September 2023 creates the National Standardisation and Quality Promotion Council and the Mauritanian Accreditation Committee, and sets the conditions on which conformity assessment bodies are accredited
note: no membership, meeting record, accredited body or published standard is held for either institution

subject: gov.standards
name: Technical assistance on public finance statistics and state-enterprise debt
milestone: Mission received 3 September 2026
position_end: The finance minister received an International Monetary Fund technical assistance mission on public finance statistics and state-owned enterprise debt, led by a regional public finance statistics adviser with the fund's resident representative present. It works on strengthening compilation in line with the 2014 government finance statistics manual, and discussions reviewed progress, results so far and next steps on the collection, reliability and consolidation of state-owned enterprise financial data
note: no baseline, target or publication commitment is stated for the state-enterprise debt data the mission is working on, so what is currently held about it stays unknown

subject: gov.discourse
name: Universal Periodic Review, fourth cycle
milestone: National rights commission's observations on the final outcome, 1 July 2026
position_end: The state's national report for the fourth cycle was submitted in November 2025, a UN education and culture body filed its contribution to the compilation, and the national human rights commission presented its observations on the final outcome in July 2026
note: the recommendations accepted and their digital-rights content are not extracted here; a country's own report and a rights commission's observations are advocacy documents on either side of the same review

subject: finance.budget
name: Digital ministry budget
position_end: US$24.2m for 2026, up 104.6% on the previous year

subject: finance.mou
name: Islamic Development Bank digital financing
milestone: Agreement in principle for US$50m, 14 April 2026
position_end: Agreed in principle for US$50m covering digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, interoperability and skills; no signed instrument, disbursement or schedule is held

milestone: Supporting the public digital service standards framework
position_end: Running; supporting the standards framework, with no output or completion report published

subject: finance.new

milestone: Committed in 2020
position_end: Committed; no completion or outcome report is held

subject: finance.new

milestone: More than EUR 43.5m committed by the EIB and the EU
position_end: Committed; the cable is not yet commissioned

subject: finance.new
name: WARDIP digital transformation programme
milestone: Extension to artificial-intelligence uses discussed with the financier, 9 June 2026
position_start: Under implementation, with the national PKI procurement and cloud build outstanding
position_end: The programme is running with published annual procurement plans for 2026 and a first update to them, and the government discussed financing an extension covering artificial-intelligence uses with the lender in June 2026; the financing agreement was ratified in Council of Ministers in December 2024
note: the procurement plans are the programme's own documents and carry intentions rather than awards; no disbursement figure or results-framework outturn is held

subject: finance.new
name: World Bank private sector, digital and human capital reform financing
milestone: US$30m IDA grant, the second of three operations
position_end: Disbursed; no third operation is on record

subject: infra.connect
name: 5G licences
milestone: Second operator signed the 5G licence specification, 13 May 2026
position_start: Did not exist; the process opened on 2 December 2025
position_end: Licences were awarded provisionally in April 2026 on the financial offers, with a third operator entering the contest; one of the operators signed the licence specification in May 2026
note: no licence fee, spectrum band, coverage obligation or launch date is published, and a provisional award is not a licence

milestone: Sole international cable since 2011
position_end: The country's only international cable in service

milestone: Full modernisation completed in Nouakchott with Huawei
position_end: Completed; no coverage, capacity or subscriber figure was published with it

milestone: Phase-1 coastal landing completed at Nouadhibou
position_start: Project launched at Nouadhibou in July 2025: 669 km, 200 Gb/s rising to 12 Tbit/s, EIB and EU financed
position_end: Phase-1 coastal landing complete at Nouadhibou, offshore laying scheduled for August 2026 and commissioning expected in the first quarter of 2027

subject: infra.connect
name: IPv6 deployment across operator networks
milestone: All licensed operators have activated IPv6 across networks and services
position_start: Adopted as a strategy in 2024 with no operator activation reported
position_end: All operators have activated IPv6, with one unnamed operator past 15% of subscribers migrated (2026-07) against a 25% end-2026 target

subject: infra.connect
name: MEDUSA cable, sub-Saharan component
milestone: EIB financing recorded for the sub-Saharan component
position_start: Financed, with no landing on record
position_end: Financed; no landing, route or commissioning date is on record

subject: infra.connect
name: National digital infrastructure company fibre network
milestone: Company headquarters inaugurated, 16 December 2025
position_end: The national digital infrastructure development company operates a national fibre-optic network of more than 1,760 kilometres on three main axes linking the country's regions; its new headquarters was inaugurated by the digital transformation minister in December 2025
note: the kilometre figure is the company's own, given at the inauguration; no route map, capacity, utilisation or wholesale tariff is published

subject: infra.connect
name: National fibre backbone under the regional connectivity programme
milestone: Implementation completion report issued, 26 August 2022
position_end: The regional communications infrastructure programme's second adaptable programme loan closed with an implementation completion and results report covering the national backbone it financed
note: the completion report is held as a document; the base does not carry its ratings, delivered kilometres or outcome indicators, and the relationship between this backbone and the national infrastructure company's 1,760 km is not established

subject: infra.connect
name: National internet exchange point
milestone: Feasibility study completed under the regional connectivity project, June 2014
position_end: Not held
note: a final feasibility study for an exchange point was completed under the regional connectivity project in 2014, setting out the state of the internet sector and its market data; nothing on the record since says whether an exchange point was ever established, and a published operator listing or peering record would settle it

subject: infra.connect
name: RIAD broadband administrative intranet
milestone: Security operations centre tendered for the network, September 2025
position_end: The broadband administrative intranet project is in build: in September 2024 the parties involved undertook to clear the obstacles holding it up and to inaugurate a first phase within the government's first hundred days, and in September 2025 a tender was opened for the emergency response team and security operations centre that would serve the network
note: nothing on the record says whether the first phase was inaugurated within the hundred days promised or at all; no site count, capacity or connected-administration figure is published

subject: infra.connect
name: Sahel digital connectivity support
milestone: Ericsson with Luxembourg and Swedish support named for Sahel connectivity
position_end: Announced; no site, capacity or delivery figure for Mauritania is published

subject: infra.connect
name: Satellite internet licences
milestone: Three firms provisionally selected across two lots
position_start: Did not exist; the tender opened on 22 January 2026
position_end: BRAINSAT, VDM and Mattel provisionally retained from nine bids, with VDM and Mattel required to match BRAINSAT's offer; no award, launch date or operating framework published
note: thirteen firms took the dossier; BRAINSAT bid US$800,000 for the mobile lot and US$3m for capacity, VDM US$50,000 and Mattel MRU 6.5m. The regulator's own communique is not held; the figures reach the wiki through Agence Ecofin's account of it

subject: infra.connect
name: Southern and south-eastern border zone mobile coverage
milestone: Service launched by the President from Kiffa, 12 December 2025
position_end: A service covering the southern and south-eastern border zones with second and fourth generation national electronic communications was launched by the President from Kiffa on 12 December 2025
note: no site count, population covered, cost, operator or funding source is published, so the launch is dated and its reach is not

subject: infra.store
name: National cloud platform
milestone: National cloud inaugurated at the data centre, 29 June 2026
position_end: The digital transformation and economic affairs ministers inaugurated the Mauritanian national cloud at the Nouakchott data centre on 29 June 2026; the digital minister told the National Assembly three days later that its launch removes the need to host the state's digital services internationally
note: no capacity, tenant, service catalogue, price list or migration figure is published, so the claim that state services need no longer be hosted abroad is a statement of capability rather than of what has moved

subject: infra.store
name: Nouakchott Tier III national data centre
milestone: Inaugurated by the President, 8 May 2025; certification route before the data protection authority, 2026-06
position_start: In service, operated by International Mauritania Telecom
position_end: Inaugurated at Nouakchott-Ouest on 8 May 2025 as the first national facility of its kind, presented as certified to international standards for storing, processing and protecting sovereign data and serving public and private institutions. It runs to 1,372 m2 and 100 server racks, stated as extensible; the data protection authority took up its certification and the hosting of data inside the country at its monthly meeting of 30 June 2026

note: the certification is asserted in the launch account and no certificate, tier rating or operator is named; a backup data centre was specified under the earlier regional connectivity programme and nothing states whether it was built. Utilisation, customers and load are unpublished

subject: infra.energy
name: Islamic Development Bank rural mini-grid electrification
milestone: Financing laws passed by the National Assembly, 31 July 2026
position_end: Two framework financing agreements signed on 19 June 2026 fund a rural electrification programme of 85 mini-grids; the National Assembly passed the bills authorising the financing on 31 July 2026
note: no amount, site list, connection target or delivery date is held, and nothing states whether any of the mini-grids serve telecommunications sites

subject: infra.energy
name: National Energy Compact
milestone: Compact issued under the continental energy access initiative
position_end: A national energy compact issued under the continental energy access initiative, setting the country's commitments on electricity access
note: the compact is held as a document; the base does not carry its access targets, financing plan or reporting arrangement, and nothing links it to the power supply for network sites and the data centre

subject: infra.energy
name: SOMELEC digital-transformation programme
milestone: FY2024 procurement plan (revised 4 December 2024) itemises a data-centre fit-out, an ERP/CRM system and smart-metering and dispatch studies, each with a target completion date
position_end: A FADES-financed data-centre fit-out (launched July 2023, due October 2024), a FADES+SOMELEC-financed ERP and CRM system with infrastructure (in procurement, due June 2025), a second IDA-financed ERP study (due December 2025), an IDA-financed geo-referenced database for the national electrification strategy with server-operations training (due October 2025), and IDA-financed advanced-metering and national-dispatch studies (due October-November 2025); two telecoms engineers recruited under AfDB financing; no item is reported complete
note: SOMELEC's own data centre, distinct from the government's Nouakchott national data centre and national cloud

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Central Bank digital reputation protection platform
milestone: Detection figures for the first half of 2026 reported by PAFIID
position_end: Operating with AI support: more than 10,000 electronic threats detected in the first half of 2026, of which 470 were confirmed and removed, and 20 digital identities protected

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National computer emergency response team
milestone: International tender opened for the CSIRT and the security operations centre, September 2025
position_end: An international two-envelope tender was opened under the regional digital integration programme for the establishment of a national computer emergency response team and a cybersecurity operations centre serving the administration's broadband intranet; the document held is its second addendum
note: a tender with an addendum is the last dated step; no award, supplier, value, staffing or commissioning date is on the record

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National Cybersecurity Strategy 2022-2025
milestone: Ran 2022 to 2025; no successor is published
position_start: In its final year, with a CERT planned
position_end: Its period has ended and no successor, evaluation or CERT is on record
note: recorded by a reference guide; the strategy text is not held

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Maadeni integrated information system
milestone: Data protection authority gave its opinion on the joint authorising decision, 24 March 2026
position_end: The data protection authority issued deliberation 002/2026 carrying its opinion on a joint decision authorising the operation of the integrated information system known as Maadeni and its interconnection with the national population register
note: what the system is for, which ministry runs it and what it draws from the register are not stated in the deliberation as held; the authority's opinion is the only record of it

subject: dpi.exchange
name: National data management system
milestone: Two-day workshop opened on data governance and blockchain, 27 July 2026
position_end: Being scoped for inter-administration integration with blockchain proposed as its trust layer, on a national blockchain policy in consultation since November 2025 naming land administration, trade, public procurement and natural-resource management; no draft text, adoption date or budget published

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Police information system and criminal data collection
milestone: 62 police, gendarmerie and customs stations connected, stated 18 December 2025
position_start: A national criminal data collection centre inaugurated in October 2021
position_end: The national police put 62 posts across the police, gendarmerie and customs onto the West African police information system, and the interior minister inaugurated a digital platform for the national police the same day
note: the accounts are the police's own anniversary and launch statements in Arabic; no record count, retention rule, data-protection authorisation or cross-border sharing arrangement is published

subject: dpi.id

milestone: Formal notices issued to the three operators, January 2026
position_start: Deactivation of non-biometric SIMs ordered in October 2023, with compliance not established
position_end: Formal notices to Mattel, Mauritel and Chinguitel with a two-month deadline before sanctions of up to 3% of turnover; no compliance outcome is on record

milestone: Named best digital government solution in Africa, 9 April 2026

position_end: The digital identity application won an African award for the best digital government solution in April 2026; national diplomas have been integrated into it, and the foreign ministry is using it to take consular and civil-status services to the diaspora

name: National Population Register
milestone: 5.1 million registered, stated to Parliament 18 June 2026
position_start: The system for running the population register and secure documents was renewed in August 2021 across 153 reception centres
position_end: More than 5.1 million people are recorded in the national register, the interior minister told Parliament on 18 June 2026; he separately described enrolment as having become a permanent public service guaranteeing every citizen's right to be registered, and the ministry's own half-year report for 2026 records the biometric interconnection of the register with civil status
sources: 2026-06-18-mrt-registre-national-population-5-1-millions-parlement|2026-06-18-ami-kassataya-enrolement-registre-national-population-service-public-permanent|2026-06-01-dgat-interieur-bilan-premier-semestre-2026-interconnexion-biometrique-etat-civil|2021-08-03-ami-anrpts-nizam-mundamij-sijil-sukkan-153-markaz-istiqbal|2026-06-18-etat-civil-parliamentary-id-exclusion-ladepeche|2025-05-20 African nations making digital ID gains in the face of common challenges (ID4Africa 2025)
note: the figure is the minister's, given in a parliamentary answer, with no denominator, coverage rate or age breakdown beside it; the base holds no independent audit of the register

subject: dpi.id
name: National public key infrastructure and certificate management system
milestone: Proposals due 21 July 2026 under the second addendum of 10 June 2026
position_end: A tender in two lots was issued under the regional digital integration programme for the design, supply, installation and implementation of a national electronic certification system: lot 1 the national public key infrastructure, lot 2 a certificate management system and its integration with the population register authority's own infrastructure. A second addendum of 10 June 2026 moved the proposal deadline and public opening to 21 July 2026 and proposal validity to 22 November 2026, financed on IDA credit 7445-MR
note: no award, supplier, value or commissioning date is on the record, and nothing states which services would authenticate against it

subject: dpi.id
name: Refugee registration and biometric identity card
milestone: Registration reported in the 2025 overview for the eastern region
position_end: Decree n. 2022-063 of 5 May 2022 replaces the 2005 decree applying the international refugee conventions, and refugee registration in the eastern region is reported in the refugee agency's 2025 overview alongside inscription in the national register
note: the decree text and an agency factsheet are what is held; no registered-refugee count, card issuance figure or statement of what the national register records for them is carried here

subject: dpi.pay
name: Electronic payment of public revenue
milestone: Workshop on the tax system for public entities and electronic invoicing, 30 July 2026
position_end: The evaluation of the public finance reform master plan for 2021-2025 carries electronic payment among the reforms assessed; the finance ministry held a seminar on non-tax revenue in May 2026 and a workshop on the tax system for public entities, electronic invoicing and remote payment in July 2026
note: no share of revenue collected electronically, participating entity count or commencement date is published; the master plan evaluation is a consultant deliverable rather than a government report

subject: dpi.pay
name: Electronic Payment Services and Means Law 2021-014
milestone: Published in the Official Gazette n. 1490, 30 July 2021
position_end: Law n. 2021-014 of 5 July 2021 on electronic payment services and means is the statute the central bank's 2022 payment-institution instructions are issued under; the Official Gazette's Arabic text is held, covering definitions, electronic payment services and means, payment cards and the contestation of a card payment
note: the held capture is an excerpt cut off partway through Titre III, so the articles the central bank cites up to 75 are not on file

subject: dpi.pay
name: GIMTEL interbank payment operator
milestone: Listed in the card scheme's global service provider registry for 2025
position_end: The interbank payment operator was entered in an international card scheme's global registry of service providers for 2025 against the card industry's data security standard, and it carries the cash-transfer component of the AOUN social transfer with the solidarity delegation and the national deposit and development fund
note: no transaction volume, value, member-bank list or uptime figure is published for the switch

subject: dpi.pay
name: PAMIF financial infrastructure modernisation
milestone: Results account published by the financier, 13 April 2026
position_end: The financier's own account puts the programme as having modernised the financial sector's plumbing, naming automated clearing and QR-code payment among what it delivered
note: the account is a success story published by the lender; no independent evaluation, transaction volume or completion report is held

subject: dpi.pay
name: Payment institutions and payment service agents regulation
milestone: Instructions 03 and 05 of 2022 issued by the central bank, 31 March 2022
position_end: The central bank's instruction 03/GR/2022 regulates payment institutions and instruction 05/GR/2022 regulates the agents of payment service providers and the protection of their customers; both were issued on 31 March 2022 and are published on the bank's fintech portal
note: no register of licensed payment institutions, agent count or supervisory action under either instruction is published

subject: dpi.pay
name: Payment, Clearing and Securities Settlement Systems Council
milestone: Council met again, 13 July 2026
position_end: The council convenes on the payment, clearing and securities settlement systems and met in May and July 2026; at the May meeting it welcomed the progress made in modernising the national financial system
note: no membership, terms of reference, minutes or decision of the council is published; the accounts are press notices of its meetings

subject: dpi.pay
name: Tax on electronic transactions
milestone: Carried in the Finance Law for 2026
position_end: A tax on electronic transactions is carried in the Finance Law for 2026, the primary text now held
note: the rate, base and exemptions are in the finance law rather than in a separate instrument; no yield figure or behavioural assessment is published

subject: dpi.registry
name: Biometric driving licences and registration plates
milestone: Ministerial statement of a before-end-2026 target, 2026-08-21
position_end: The equipment and transport minister stated that driving licences and vehicle registration plates would be digitised and issued in biometric form before the end of 2026, alongside continued reform of the land transport directorate
note: a stated target; no procurement, supplier or system specification is published

subject: dpi.registry
name: Database of poor and vulnerable households affected by disasters
milestone: Created by decree 2025-162 of 15 October 2025
position_end: Decree n. 2025-162 of 15 October 2025 creates a special database for poor and vulnerable households affected by disasters, the Council of Ministers having approved it the previous month
note: no operator, household count, data-sharing rule or relationship to the social register is stated in what is held

subject: dpi.registry
name: Geolocated addressing system
milestone: Terms of reference issued, 10 March 2025
position_end: Terms of reference were issued under the regional digital integration programme for support to the national postal company to implement a geolocated addressing system, presented as favouring the development of commerce and electronic commerce in particular
note: terms of reference are the last dated step; no award, supplier, coverage, address standard or delivery date is on the record

subject: dpi.registry
name: National information system for the central criminal-record register
milestone: Information system for the central criminal-record register before the Council of Ministers, 27 August 2026
position_end: The criminal record was digitised and online access to it launched in March 2025; the information system for the central register went before the Council of Ministers in August 2026 alongside the cadastral referential
note: no issuance volume, processing time or retention rule is published for the online record

subject: dpi.registry
name: Referentiel national numerique des donnees foncieres et cadastrales
milestone: Cadastral referential and unique parcel identifier before the Council of Ministers, 27 August 2026
position_start: No integrated cadastral survey system meeting these requirements
position_end: The national digital referential for land and cadastral data is being built out: the property ministry launched the digitisation of the land sector in January 2026, opened a digital census of built parcels in Nouakchott carrying a unique identifier in May 2026, and held a workshop on a land data warehouse under the AAKAR project; a Council of Ministers decree of September 2025 provides for electronic land transactions and their interoperability
note: no parcel count, coverage figure, completion date or link to the population register is published, so the referential is dated and its extent is not

subject: dpi.registry
name: Registered voters
position_end: 1,939,343 registered voters, on the Constitutional Council's proclamation of the definitive results of the presidential election of 2024
note: the figure is the roll at the 2024 presidential election; no later revision, audit or relationship to the national population register is on the record

subject: dpi.registry
name: Rural land concession registration platform
milestone: Registration window open to 18 September 2026
position_end: The technical committee on the rural land and developer-plot allocation file called on all holders of rural land concessions inside the capital's urban zone to register on a national platform, running to 18 September 2026 with staffed help desks in the capital's three moughataas, following a declaration presented to the Council of Ministers on 28 April 2026
note: a two-week window with a hard deadline and no stated consequence for holders who miss it, no expected registration count and no description of what the platform does with a registration once made

subject: dpi.registry
name: Social Register
milestone: Verification platform opened for the AOUN transfer to registered households, June 2026
position_start: The register underpinning the safety-net programme, with an electronic payment platform delivered under the first World Bank safety-net project
position_end: A verification platform was opened for the AOUN transfer covering more than 2,057,006 citizens recorded in the social register, its cash-transfer component run by the solidarity delegation with the national deposit and development fund and the interbank payment operator; the delegation ran a coordination round to update the register across the Nouakchott wilayas in April 2026, and the TEKAVOUL programme behind it was re-established by decree 2024-073 of 15 May 2024
note: the 2,057,006 is the number registered rather than the number paid, and no payment completion figure, exclusion-error estimate or grievance route is published

subject: dpi.registry
name: Tax identification number
milestone: Common provisions of the tax procedures book published, 7 October 2019
position_end: The common provisions of the tax procedures book carry the tax identification number and the obligations attaching to it
note: no registered-taxpayer count, coverage figure or link to the business or population registers is published

subject: dpi.registry
name: Trade register and movable securities regime
milestone: Law 2021-005 amending the Commercial Code, 10 February 2021
position_end: Law n. 2021-005 of 10 February 2021 amends, completes and repeals provisions of the Commercial Code of 2000, carrying the trade register and the regime for movable securities
note: nothing on the record says whether either register is operated electronically, or how many entries either holds

subject: dpi.registry
name: Unified digital consular registry
milestone: Live for the Riyadh mission's zone of competence
position_end: Live for Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and the Maldives, registering residence, geographic distribution and permitted activities and building a digital register of national skills abroad
note: the consular registration desk remains the competent authority, so the platform layers onto the registry rather than replacing it

subject: dpi.mis
name: Education certificate service on Houwiyeti
milestone: Launched for extraction and confirmation of national education certificates
position_start: In service for certificates issued after 2013 or linked to the national identity number
position_end: In service; no usage figure is held

subject: dpi.mis
name: National health information system
milestone: Electronic consultation register reported working in two wilayas, 17 July 2026
position_start: An order of 14 December 2021 fixing the organisation and operation of the regional health system and its data collection
position_end: An electronic consultation register is producing usable epidemic-response data in Hodh El Chargui and Hodh El Gharbi on the World Health Organization's account; the health minister said in January 2026 that work was under way to generalise the model reference hospitals' information systems, the ministry discussed digitising the health system with the World Bank in March 2026, and the DIGISANTE project held its site-selection meeting in April 2026
note: no facility count, completeness rate, reporting timeliness figure or national rollout date is published; the health development plan for 2021-2030 and a primary-health-care performance assessment sit behind it

subject: dpi.mis
name: Siraj education platform
milestone: Forty laptops delivered to support the platform in Trarza, 12 June 2026
position_end: The education and digital transformation ministers met in March 2026 on the Siraj platform and agreed a common action plan; forty laptops were delivered in Trarza in June 2026 to support digitisation in the education sector behind it
note: what the platform does, how many schools it reaches and when it is to be completed are not stated in what is held; the wider digital-school programme and the education partnership compact sit beside it

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Ain citizen complaints platform
milestone: Twelve-month result reported to the Council of Ministers, 19 November 2025
position_start: Launched by the Prime Minister on 22 October 2024 to receive and handle citizens' complaints
position_end: The digital transformation minister told the government spokesman's briefing that 97 per cent of the complaints and reports the platform received in its first twelve months had been handled
note: handled is the minister's own word and no volume, category breakdown, resolution time or outcome is published beside the percentage, so what 97 per cent counts is not established

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Digital consular services platform
milestone: Launched 9 July 2026 with a first phase of nine online services
position_end: Live, delivering consular registration, the consular card, travel authorisation, legalisation, powers of attorney, appointments and burial and repatriation permits without attending the mission
note: built by diaspora engineers with the digital ministry after consultations in 22 countries

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Digitised civil service recruitment competition
milestone: Candidates sat the digitised competition, reported 9 July 2026
position_end: The competition for 3,000 state officials and agents was run through the services portal end to end, the digital minister having said in February 2026 that the whole recruitment process would be digitised, with artificial intelligence used in preparing and marking it; candidates interviewed after sitting it praised the transparency of the process
note: how artificial intelligence was used in marking is not set out, no error, appeal or audit arrangement is published, and the candidate reaction is reported rather than surveyed

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Digitised civil-service recruitment
milestone: 390-post competition run digitally from application to examination (2026-08)
position_end: Applications filed through the Khadematy platform and examinations sat on digital tablets at Nouakchott, for a 390-post competition inside a wider 3,000-post programme
note: the first competition the base holds that is digital end to end rather than at the application stage only; no candidate count, marking method, accessibility provision or fallback for a candidate unable to use a tablet is published, and nothing states how the results are audited

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Electronic invoicing for public institutions
milestone: Announced by the Finance Minister, 30 July 2026
position_end: Announced, to handle VAT and withholding at source by transferring data automatically to the tax directorate; no instrument, supplier or date published

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Ijraati administrative procedures portal
milestone: Launched consolidating more than 800 administrative procedures
position_end: Live as a directory of more than 800 procedures with documents, processing times, agencies and tracking; no usage figure published
sources: 2026-02-22 Mauritania Centralizes 800 Administrative Procedures in New Digital Portal (Ijraati)

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Khdamati remote transactions platform
milestone: Water utility services added to the portal, 4 August 2026
position_start: Planned, with nothing on record in service
position_end: The national services portal is carrying services from across government: instant notification of road-traffic offences through the national road transport system, online university enrolment in place of the paper process, the Hajj platform connected to it, the health solidarity fund's services, the digitisation of building-permit applications across the Nouakchott wilayas with payment by electronic wallet, and the water utility's services
sources: 2026-08-04-ami-raqmana-khadamat-sharika-mouritaniya-lilma-boabat-khadamati|2026-05-12-ami-cnass-services-numeriques-khidmati|2026-03-12-ami-permis-de-construire-khadematy-paiement-portefeuilles-electroniques|2025-12-23-ami-plateforme-hajj-connexion-khadamati-anrpts|2025-09-29-mtnima-tesjil-inscription-universitaire-en-ligne-khidmaty|2025-04-07-mtnima-sntr-khidmaty-modele-ia-an-etat-plaques-infractions|2026-08-13-mauritania-diwan-khidmaty-digitalization-german-cooperation|2026-02-22 Mauritania Centralizes 800 Administrative Procedures in New Digital Portal (Ijraati)
note: the portal is transliterated variously as Khidmaty, Khidmati, Khadamati and Khdamati across the sources; no service count, transaction volume, user base or availability figure is published for it

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Online tax filing for large enterprises
milestone: 39 per cent of large enterprises filing online, reported March 2026
position_end: The lender's implementation status report puts 39 per cent of large enterprises filing tax online; the revenue directorate's strategic plan for 2025-2029 carries remote declaration among its objectives
note: the 39 per cent is a project indicator reported by the financier, with no denominator, target or comparison for other taxpayer segments published beside it

subject: dpi.govtech
name: SNDE services on the Mes Services portal
milestone: Water utility services integrated into the portal from 4 August 2026
position_end: Live, with the utility's transactions available remotely; German cooperation was credited without an amount, instrument or term, and no usage figure exists

subject: dpi.govtech
name: STT electronic tax services platform
milestone: Adoption by public bodies disclosed at a tax workshop, 30 July 2026
position_end: Live, with 66 public bodies enrolled, 53 filing electronically and 3 paying through it, against 642 legally constituted public bodies of which 339 are active with the tax administration
note: around 20 public bodies are absent from the national taxpayer register; more than 500 taxpayers overall are on the tax directorate's electronic platform, producing 36.45% of directorate revenue in 2026

subject: dpi.govtech
name: SYDONIA World customs system
milestone: Carried in the fund programme's fifth review, February 2026
position_start: Accessible over the internet from February 2023, with a published user guide
position_end: The customs system is reached over the internet under a user guide the finance ministry published in February 2023; the monetary fund's fifth programme review of February 2026 carries the customs and tax administration reforms running on it, alongside the free-zone arrangements
note: no declaration volume, clearance time or coverage figure is published; the fund report is a programme review rather than an evaluation of the system

subject: digital.localgov
name: Municipal or regional digital services
milestone: Annual local-finance bulletin published from the SIGEL system, 2026-07
position_end: Local government carries two dated digital positions: an annual bulletin on communal finances is produced from the local financial management system, and a ministry report on the institutional capacity of Mauritanian communes sets out what the tier can and cannot run. Service delivery to citizens at that tier is reaching them through digital counters rather than through municipal systems - one opened at Bassikounou and a digital space at Ouadane
note: no commune runs a digital service of its own on the record; the counters are the central ministry's, and the finance system is the Treasury's

subject: tech.ai
name: Artificial-intelligence agrometeorological early warning system
milestone: Workshop on the system held at Rosso, 14 January 2026
position_end: A workshop was held at Rosso in January 2026 on an artificial-intelligence agrometeorological early warning system run by the meteorological office with a UN development agency; a separate hydrometeorological early warning system for the Senegal River valley is described by its developer as artificial-intelligence powered
note: neither account states what the models do, what data they use, who receives the warnings or whether either system is in operation; the second is a developer's own project page

subject: tech.ai
name: Media programme on synthetic content and deepfakes
milestone: Programme session held in Nouakchott with the media regulator, 2 July 2026
position_end: A European-supported programme on artificial intelligence and the information space ran a session in Nouakchott with the audiovisual regulator, on deepfakes and synthetic media
note: no regulatory instrument, guideline or enforcement power on synthetic media follows from it on the record; the account is the implementing organisation's own

subject: tech.ai
name: National AI Strategy 2025-2029
milestone: Draft strategy for 2024-2029 published by the ministry
position_start: Recorded as existing, the text not held
position_end: The draft national artificial-intelligence strategy runs on five strategic priorities, twelve objectives and thirty measures, covering skills and certification in AI and data science, research and innovation, international collaboration, data governance and ethical use, with sector projects named in health, education, agriculture, fisheries, transport, energy and defence. The document held is a draft dated April 2024
note: the base holds a draft and no adoption instrument, budget or implementation report; the ministry's own dating of the strategy period varies between accounts, the draft carrying 2024-2029

subject: tech.ai
name: National framework for artificial intelligence in the Republican School
milestone: Framework launched by the First Lady, 20 January 2026
position_end: A national framework for artificial intelligence in the service of the Republican School was launched on 20 January 2026
note: the framework text is not held and no budget, school coverage, safeguard for pupils' data or implementation timetable is published

subject: tech.ai
name: Open datasets for Mauritania's national languages
milestone: Open natural-language repository published for Pulaar, Soninke and Hassaniya
position_end: Two open repositories carry language data for the country's languages: a Hassaniya dialect dataset collection published on a model-hosting platform in January 2026, and an open natural-language processing hub for Pulaar, Soninke and Hassaniya published on a code-hosting platform in May 2026
note: both are community repositories rather than state assets; no size, licence, provenance or quality assessment is recorded here, and neither is named in the national artificial-intelligence strategy

subject: tech.industry
name: Mobile operator market
milestone: A fourth operator entered at the 5G award
position_start: Three licensed operators: Mauritel, Mattel and Chinguitel
position_end: Four, with the new entrant Rimatel licensed alongside the three incumbents

subject: tech.innovate
name: Hadina RIMTIC technology incubator
milestone: Operating from Nouakchott
position_end: A technology incubator at Nouakchott supporting startups and small and medium enterprises to grow, presenting itself as building an entrepreneurial base with economic, social and sustainable impact
note: the record is the incubator's own site; no cohort count, funding, survival rate or public support is published

subject: tech.innovate
name: Nouakchott AI Build hackathon
milestone: One-day build held, 17 May 2026
position_end: A one-day artificial-intelligence build was held at Nouakchott on 17 May 2026 to launch working projects in the country
note: the record is the event's own site; no participant count, project outcome or follow-on support is established from it

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital literacy measurement
note: searched again on 2026-09-06 across the statistics agency's releases, the regulator's annual report, the global financial-inclusion survey for 2025 and the international telecommunication union's country dashboard: all four carry access and use measures, none carries a measurement of digital literacy or skills. A household survey module or a skills assessment would settle it

subject: capacity.training
name: Cybersecurity and artificial-intelligence training for state officials
milestone: Programme launched for 300 officials, 15 December 2025
position_end: A capacity-building programme in cybersecurity was launched in December 2025 for 300 state officials
note: no curriculum, duration, provider, funding source or completion figure is published

subject: capacity.training
name: National continuing training policy
milestone: Study findings presented at a restitution workshop, 7 May 2026
position_end: The public service and labour ministry held a restitution workshop in May 2026 on the study for a national continuing training policy
note: the study itself is not held and no policy text, adoption step or digital-skills component is stated

subject: capacity.training
name: Summer school on language models for low-resource African languages
milestone: First edition opened 2026-08-25
position_end: First edition opened at Nouadhibou by the University of Nouakchott, taking participants through corpus construction and semantic annotation, model adaptation, training and evaluation, and on to prototypes in translation and conversational assistants
note: no participant count, budget or repeat commitment is stated; a German development agency spoke at the opening

subject: capacity.training
name: Tamekoun national digital skills platform
milestone: Presented at a ministry workshop, 10 June 2024
position_end: A national platform for training public servants in essential digital skills, presented at a ministry workshop in June 2024
note: no enrolment, completion or curriculum figure is published, and nothing on the record since 2024 says whether the platform is in use

subject: capacity.training
name: Youth digital employability programme
milestone: Launched for 2,150 beneficiaries across six cities, 23 July 2026
position_start: Predecessor programme Tech pour la Mauritanie, closed in 2025
position_end: Running for 2,150 beneficiaries across six cities, about 2,000 of them young people, financed by France's Fonds Equipe France and implemented by Simplon
note: the implementer puts its three-year record at about 5,000 people given basic digital skills

subject: capacity.training
name: Youth employment in the digital sector
milestone: Forum on youth employment in the digital sector opened, 7 July 2026
position_end: A forum on youth employment in the digital sector opened in July 2026; the youth empowerment ministry separately visited the employment counter in June 2026 and set out new programmes, artificial intelligence being named among the tools brought into occupational guidance there
note: no placement, enrolment or vacancy figure is published for either, and how artificial intelligence is used in the guidance is not stated

subject: capacity.research
name: National digital or data research programme
milestone: CNESRS-accredited under arrêté 183 (17 February 2022) for May 2021 to May 2024; no renewal is on record
position_end: Calcul Scientifique, Informatique et Data Sciences unit at the Faculté des Sciences et Techniques, Université de Nouakchott, with 16 doctoral candidates concentrated in AI and data science (5G optimisation, blockchain/IoT process mining, health-data management, cloud-resource elasticity) and three theses defended in 2022; the accreditation period ended May 2024 with no renewal published

subject: include.access
name: Connectivity and financial inclusion, global survey
position_end: The 2025 round of the global financial inclusion survey carries the country's connectivity and financial inclusion measures; the international telecommunication union's country dashboard carries its infrastructure and access measures as at December 2023
note: both are held as catalogue records of the underlying releases rather than as extracted figures, so this row records that the measures exist and are dated and does not state their values

subject: include.access
name: Disability rights framework and its implementing decrees
milestone: National rights commission observed the missing implementing decrees, 1 July 2026
position_end: Ordinance n. 2006-043 on the promotion and protection of persons with disabilities is the frame; the national human rights commission's observations on the periodic review in July 2026 record that implementing decrees for the disability law are outstanding. Transfers were made to 6,000 children with special needs around the international day in December 2025
note: nothing on the record addresses digital accessibility of public services for disabled users, which is the question this row would otherwise answer

subject: data.statistics
name: Fifth general population and housing census
milestone: Definitive census results presented regionally and poverty indicators to the Council of Ministers, 2026
position_end: The definitive results of the fifth census were presented at regional workshops from February 2026, and a communication on the movement of poverty and household living conditions between 2019 and 2025 went to the Council of Ministers in August 2026 on the household survey that accompanies it
note: the census results themselves are not held as a dataset, and the poverty communication is summarised in a Council communique rather than published as a report

subject: data.statistics
name: National Decadal Statistics Development Strategy 2021-2030
milestone: Strategy and first action plan for 2021-2025 published
position_end: The decadal strategy for developing the statistical system runs to 2030 with an action plan for 2021-2025; the statistics agency's orientation council was named in Council of Ministers in March 2026, and the agency publishes monthly statistical bulletins carrying a communications price index
note: the first action plan's period has run out and no successor plan or implementation report is held; the bulletins are reported in the press rather than held as data

subject: data.statistics
name: National Youth Empowerment Index
milestone: Reference document presented at a Nouakchott workshop, 29 July 2026
position_end: Published in preliminary form at 60.5 out of 100 for 2026, across five domains built from 43 secondary indicators, education and training strongest at 69.5% and health and sport weakest at 46.1%

subject: data.statistics
name: Regulator's market observatory and annual report
milestone: Annual report for 2023 published by the regulatory authority
position_end: The regulatory authority publishes an annual report carrying its market observatory
note: the 2023 edition is the newest held; no quarterly series, subscriber count or machine-readable release accompanies it, so market data reaches the base a year or more late

subject: data.open
name: Electronic Journal Officiel portal
milestone: Launch workshop held, 24 November 2025
position_end: A workshop was held on 24 November 2025 to launch the electronic portal of the Journal Officiel
note: a launch workshop is the last dated step; no portal address, coverage of back issues, search or bulk-download arrangement is on the record

subject: data.open
name: National open data portal
milestone: National open-data strategy published, June 2023, naming the existing portal and proposing a governance overhaul
position_end: mauritania.opendataforafrica.org, run by ANSADE, carries 24 downloadable datasets from 4 public providers — last of four benchmarked countries (Mauritania, Morocco, Senegal, Tunisia) on every published measure — with no Open Government Partnership membership; a June 2023 strategy proposes a new governance framework, portal redesign and reviving the decree creating an Agence Numérique de l'État as operator, none of which is reported delivered

subject: data.open
name: Systematic disclosure of extractive industries data
milestone: Moderate score against the 2019 extractive transparency standard, 12 November 2024
position_start: Decree n. 2019-141/PM requiring systematic disclosure of extractive industries data
position_end: The transparency initiative's board found in November 2024 that Mauritania had achieved a moderate score in implementing the 2019 standard, against a decree of June 2019 requiring the systematic disclosure of extractive industries data
note: the score is the initiative's own validation finding; what is actually disclosed systematically, and in what format, is not established by what is held

subject: data.satellite
name: Meteorological satellite reception and earth observation capacity
milestone: New satellite reception infrastructure installed and inspected, 23 September 2025
position_end: The continental body invested in new climate services and satellite reception infrastructure for the national meteorological and hydrological services, inspected in September 2025; the meteorological office runs to a strategic plan for 2024-2030, and a continental earth-observation programme held its fourth national workshop on using earth observation for natural resource management in July 2025
note: no station count, data product, availability figure or user of the outputs is published; the strategic plan is held as a document and its implementation is not reported

subject: geopol.usa
name: United States clean energy cooperation memorandum
milestone: Memorandum signed between the two energy ministries, 3 December 2023
position_end: A memorandum of understanding between the United States energy department and the petroleum, mines and energy ministry on clean energy cooperation
note: the memorandum text is held; no value, work programme, duration or activity under it is on the record since

subject: geopol.china
name: Urban security system
milestone: Chinese government grant of MUR 629.4m through ETCA
position_end: Granted; no delivery, siting or oversight arrangement for the system is on record

subject: geopol.gulf
name: Oman digital cooperation agreement
milestone: Five memoranda signed between Omani and Mauritanian institutions and companies, 30 July 2026
position_end: Five memoranda of understanding were signed between Omani and Mauritanian institutions and companies at a digitisation forum
